messages:
marta: starting a hotfix deploy request for tokenizer edge-case that silently corrupts short inputs. CI: green. Requesting fast-path approvals for prod change window (EU morning). canary -> 10% for 5m then 50%.
deploy-bot: deploy requested by marta: hotfix/tokenizer v3.2.1 -> prod. CI status: all checks passed. Starting preflight: canary config queued.
samir: ack, saw the failure in sentry; reproducer looks small. Approving expedited deploy if we pin the rollout and set strict rollback thresholds. :+1:
ashley: security note: this touches input parsing but no new data exfil paths. I can approve but want audit log retention set to 90d for this rollout and KMS key usage logged.
marta: noted, ashley — will enable audit retention. ops, can we set pin after canary so we can rollback to previous tokenizer:v3.2.0 quickly?
leo: we should pin the canary variant so requests that need the old behavior stay on v3.2.0 if we rollback. Suggest command:
```bash
rdwctl rollout apply --service tokenizer --image tokenizer:v3.2.1 --canary 10 --pin-after-canary true
```
leo: also add routing policy fallback to tokenizer:v3.2.0 for EU region in case of capacity issues.
ops-bot: canary started at 10% (tokenizer:v3.2.1) — monitoring group: tokenizer-hotfix-1768135799.
ops-bot: initial canary metrics (1m): errors 0.02%, p95 latency +3ms vs baseline, token-mismatch 0.01% — all within baseline.
ravi-pm: product sign-off: this fixes a customer-facing corruption bug in message snippets; support is queued to notify impacted customers. Approving expedited rollout.
samir: setting rollback criteria now. If any of these trigger for 5 consecutive mins, automatic rollback to v3.2.0:
- error_rate_increase >0.5% absolute
- token_mismatch_rate >0.5% absolute
- p95_latency increase >200ms absolute
- customer_alerts >= 3 in 10m
marta: putting the checklist here for ops runbook and oncall:
1) monitor tokenizer-hotfix-1768135799 dashboard
2) if auto-rollback triggers, notify #incidents and @oncall
3) manually trigger rollback: `rdwctl rollout rollback --service tokenizer --to-version v3.2.0`
4) if rollback fails, escalate to infra oncall and freeze external traffic
ashley: approved (security) — audit retention set. :white_check_mark:
samir: approved (eng lead) — pin after canary enabled. :rocket:
deploy-bot: canary at 10% completed (5m). Metrics stable. Proceeding to 50% canary. Starting 10m observation window.
ops-bot: 50% canary metrics (3m): errors 0.03%, p95 +4ms, token_mismatch 0.02%.
leo: tagging the release notes draft: "tokenizer: fix short-input corruption; v3.2.1 — hotfix". Will push changelog after full rollout.
marta: full rollout to 100% scheduled if 10m window stays green. Requesting release manager to mark as expedited after full rollout.
ravi-pm: noted, will update release notes and customer comms on success.
ops-bot: observation window complete, metrics stable. Rolling to 100%.
deploy-bot: rollout to 100% in progress. Pinning tokenizer to v3.2.1 post-rollout.
ops-bot: rollout complete. tokenizer:v3.2.1 at 100% in prod-eu. Pin applied.
marta: closing loop — thanks all. Post-deploy followups: regression evals run tomorrow and I'll open a short postmortem doc if anything odd appears.
samir: leaving a rollback window of 2 hours for quick rev if customer reports come in.
ops-bot: audit log entry created: rollout 1768135799, initiator=marta, pinned=true, retention=90d."
